name: Sinful Life
source:
Who did it? Who is to blame for your father's death? It is your job to find out. You will need to manipulate, device, and charm all that come and try to stop you.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/boomx]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
是谁干的？谁该为父亲的死负责？查明真相，是你的任务。面对所有前来阻挠的人，你必须操纵、算计，或凭魅力将其征服。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/boomx]Patreon[/url]]
